The image features several loose bandages in beige and red, some with visible absorbent pads. There is also a large, distorted representation of a Band-Aid box or wrapper with significant text gibberish ('ONANE', 'Bicetla & G MNE') and a circular logo that appears melted or structurally unsound. A small tube of ointment is visible on the left.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text artifacts. In AI-generated images, text is often the first thing to fail. Even if the bandages themselves look realistic, the catastrophic failure of the text and logo in the background suggests a low-quality generation process that may have introduced subtle structural errors in the bandages themselves (e.g., incorrect pad proportions or impossible folding). Do not let the realistic appearance of the small beige bandages mask the severe semantic errors in the background.
